Done. `out/T5/` holds 4 shards + `model.safetensors.index.json`, 244 tensors.

Approach: a direct safetensors/torch script (`out/T5/solution.py`), no model instantiation.

- Adapter names mapped by regex, stripping `base_model.model.` and `.lora_{A,B}.weight`.
- `W += (alpha/r) * B @ A` in float32, cast back to float16; `fan_in_fan_out` read from the config and applied conditionally (false here, so no transpose).
- Required checks assert before writing: 16 pairs merged, no `lora_` keys, layer-0 qkv still `[6144, 2048]`, 244 tensors. Post-write it re-reads every shard and re-verifies the key set and the 512 MiB *tensor-data* budget (file sizes exceed it slightly due to safetensors headers — the budget is summed from `numel * element_size`).

I skipped `peft.merge_and_unload` on purpose: it would force loading the full model through `transformers` and cede control of sharding and the key set to `save_pretrained`, for what is 16 rank-16 matmuls. Rationale is in `out/T5/REPORT.md`.

Two executions, both successful; the second was just a re-run after removing a redundant assertion. I could not run `grade.py` — it isn't present in this sandbox.
